title.narrative: UN Women Gender and governance Elections violence prevention

description.narrative: Partner: UN Women OHCHRTitle of project: 'Amplifying Women’s Voices in the Prevention of Violence against Women in Elections in Bungoma and Vihiga Counties project'Project Objective: To prevent violence against women in elections (VAWE), thereby contributing to greater participation and representation of women in political leadership.Project Activities:a) Strengthening the capacity of rights holders (grassroots women’s rights groups, sub-county peace committees and networks of WHRDs) to play a leading role in peacebuilding efforts, prior to, during and after the electoral process, and holding duty bearers to account for peaceful elections and prevention of VAWEb) Strengthening the capacity of county and sub-county structures that deliver on prevention of VAWE, to ensure stronger coordination of interventions, including timely establishment of gender-responsive early warning systems and contingency planning in the two targeted countiesc) Capacitating key institutions to provide oversight in the implementation of early warning systems, including linking the county based VAWE prevention measures to the national level mechanisms. The State Department for Gender Affairs will play a key link role as it steers all gender related interventions at national and county level. The gender department is key in the process of convening and facilitating contingency planning jointly with the county administration
